title: Exact Digit-Sum Count
prompt:
**Problem.** Each line: L R K (read until EOF). Print one integer
per line: the count of x in [L, R] with digit sum exactly K.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ q ≤ 20000; 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ 10^18; 1 ≤ K ≤ 162.

Budget-state digit DP: (position, remaining budget, tight). The W drops
the tight chain and undercounts every boundary.

tests.name: tiny windows
tests.hint: 14, 23, 32, 41, 50, and 5 itself: 6 numbers in 1..100 with digit sum 5.

tests.name: 1..500 sum 10
max digit sum
boundary: exactly 10^18 sum 162
boundary: sum 161
tests.hint: Eighteen nines minus one: 18 numbers (one digit is 8).

tests.name: load: 20000 heavy queries
tests.hint: Each query is an independent 19-digit tight walk — the DP table is rebuilt per query, 20000 x O(19*163*10) ops.
